title: Trapped in a Cage, I Heal the Paranoid Mafia Boss
description: Damian, heir to the Voss family, was kidnapped by enemies at the age of six and raised in a hellish environment to become a bloodthirsty weapon. Twenty years later, he returns bathed in blood and becomes a gang boss—only to discover that his parents have long since replaced his identity with his younger brother Julian, and that Ivy, who had been betrothed to him since childhood, has become Julian's fiancée. Damian forcibly takes Ivy back. After Julian and Ivy are in a car accident on a rainy night, he seizes the opportunity while Ivy has amnesia to imprison her by his side, disguising himself as her husband. Ivy struggles to survive amid chains and lies, playing the obedient wife while secretly searching for the truth. She gradually discovers that she is Damian's only light, and she also teaches this scarred man to be gentle. However, as her memories begin to recover, the two constantly test each other's true hearts, and Damian's enemies reappear. The secret her parents have hidden for twenty years is also peeled back layer by layer—Ivy's biological mother has actually been imprisoned for years. Facing betrayal, blood, and the truth, Ivy finally sees Damian's obsessive yet utterly sincere heart. Two loves torn apart by fate, between the cage and freedom, finally find a path to reconciliation.
